confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant meal and coffee anchors are the more reliable; accommodation is least certain because Udaipur spans budget guesthouses to heritage hotels with wide price spreads. July falls in monsoon season, when tourist demand is lower and some rates are softer. Alcohol prices are sensitive to state excise and licensing, so beer, cocktail and wine are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (roughly 2x and 3x beer) because direct knowledge of bar and restaurant wine prices is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the regional basis of other Rajasthan tourist cities such as Jodhpur and Jaipur, adjusted for Udaipur's lake-city tourism profile and July monsoon timing. No specific city listings were consulted.
